lead: A visitor may want a scheduled class, a private group experience or a general visit to a teaching business. I help Windsor County businesses make those choices clear before a customer follows the wrong booking route.
decisionTitle: Explain the learning experience before the calendar handoff.
decision: King Arthur Baking's Norwich location combines a school, café and store, while its school information distinguishes class formats and private-group requests. For an illustrative teaching business, a useful website should explain what the customer is choosing: a particular class, a group program to discuss or a visit that does not itself enroll anyone. I can improve those distinctions on an existing site or build a fuller introduction connecting learning goals, preparation and the proper next step.
